verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent along the X axis (base length of the L-bracket).
verification_targets.notes: Base runs 50 mm in X; with centroid_on_base_plane origin the faces sit at X = -25 and X = +25.

verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent along the Y axis (base width / extrusion depth of the L-profile).
verification_targets.notes: Base is 30 mm wide; the L-profile is extruded the full 30 mm along Y so Y faces sit at -15 and +15.

verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent along the Z axis (base thickness plus vertical leg rise).
verification_targets.notes: ABSOLUTE value from Z=0 bottom face. Base occupies Z = 0..5; vertical leg rises to Z = 30 (LEG_TOTAL_HEIGHT_Z). Leg height above the base is inferred as LEG_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE_Z = 25 mm since the request did not state it.

verification_targets.description: The finished bracket must be one connected solid (base plate and vertical leg fused into a single body, no free-floating shells).
verification_targets.notes: L-profile must be a single continuous extrusion, not two joined plates.

verification_targets.description: The finished solid must be a closed, watertight manifold mesh suitable for printing or machining.
verification_targets.notes: All faces closed; the 6 mm through-hole must break both base surfaces cleanly.

functional_requirements: Base plate 50 mm x 30 mm providing a flat mounting/resting surface.
Single 6 mm diameter hole centered on the base footprint for fastening/clearance.
Vertical leg at one end giving the part its 90-degree L-profile.
Uniform 5 mm material thickness across base and leg.
special_features: The part MUST be a single solid formed by extruding an L-shaped profile defined in the XZ plane along the Y axis for BASE_WIDTH_Y (30 mm), not two separate perpendicular plates.
The 6 mm hole MUST be a single through-hole penetrating the base vertically along the Z axis.
The 6 mm hole MUST be centered on the base footprint at (HOLE_CENTER_X = 0, HOLE_CENTER_Y = 0), i.e. at the centroid of the 50 x 30 base, not offset toward an edge.
The 6 mm hole MUST NOT intersect the vertical leg (hole radius HOLE_RADIUS = 3 mm must stay clear of the leg inner face at LEG_INNER_FACE_X = 20 mm).
The vertical leg MUST rise from the +X edge of the base, occupying X from LEG_INNER_FACE_X (20 mm) to LEG_OUTER_FACE_X (25 mm) and spanning the full BASE_WIDTH_Y (30 mm) in Y.
The vertical leg MUST extend from the bottom face Z=0 up to LEG_TOTAL_HEIGHT_Z = 30 mm, giving LEG_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE_Z = 25 mm above the top of the 5 mm base.
Base and leg MUST share the uniform THICKNESS_Z = 5 mm wall thickness.
